Eastern Times published the following article on November 28:-
YOUNG MISTRESS FALLS IN LOVE WITH CHAUFFEUR.
Lieu Tse Yung(劉子容 ), formerly a student
of St. John's University at Jessfield Village, is the
youngest son of Lieu Hui Ts(劉惠慈 ), native of Anhwei,
manager of the Industrial Bank of China(中國實業銀行).
He is 22 years old. Four years ago he married a girl named
Yee Yung Ching(奚雲卿 ) and lived at House No.48 Chung Hsih
Sin Chun Terrace(中實新村 ), Yu Yuen Road. At this time,
Lieu ceased his studies and worked in the Industrial Bank of
China at a monthly pay of $60. He owned a motor car.
After his marriage, Lieu often spent his
nights away from home. Meanwhile, Yee Yung Ching became
pregnant. Last winter, a son was born. Nevertheless,
there was not much love between husband and wife, so much
so that Yee Yung Ching became dissatisfied.
Realizing the situation, Lieu's chauffeur
named Wu Wen Hsiang(吳文祥 ), aged 22, took advantage of
the opportunity to offer consolation to his mistress and
eventually induced her into "flesh" relations with him.
Their love was genuine. The secret was discovered by
Lieu this year, and the chauffeur was dismissed. However,
Yee's love for her chauffeur remained. On July 4 (lunar
calendar) Yee, after packing her clothing and ornaments as
well as a sum of several tens of thousands of dollars in
banknotes, eloped with the chauffeur. They first rented
a house at Chu Yuen Fang(朱園浜), Yu Yuen Road, and lived
like husband and wife. Later, they removed to House 84,
Chi Hsiang Fang(吉祥坊 ), Chien Ka Tong(錢家塘), Avenue
Joffre.
After the elopement of his wife, Lieu reported
the case to the Police, and removed all his furniture to his
old home. He then returned to school to continue his studies.

《东方时报》（Eastern Times）于11月28日刊登了以下文章：
少奶奶爱上司机。
刘子容 (Lieu Tse Yung)，前极司菲尔路（Jessfield Village）圣约翰大学学生，是安徽籍中国实业银行经理刘惠慈 (Lieu Hui Ts) 的幼子。他现年22岁。四年前，他娶了一位名叫奚云卿 (Yee Yung Ching) 的女子为妻，居住在愚园路中实新村48号。此时，刘子容辍学，在中国实业银行工作，月薪60元。他拥有一辆汽车。
婚后，刘子容经常夜不归宿。与此同时，奚云卿怀孕。去年冬天，生下一子。然而，夫妻之间感情淡薄，致使奚云卿心生不满。
刘子容的司机吴文祥 (Wu Wen Hsiang)，现年22岁，察觉此情况后，趁机向女主人献殷勤安慰，并最终诱使她与其发生肉体关系。两人的感情是真挚的。今年，此事被刘子容发觉，司机被解雇。然而，奚氏对司机的爱意未减。农历七月四日，奚氏将衣物、首饰以及数万元现钞打包后，与司机私奔。他们起初在愚园路朱园浜租了一处房屋，以夫妻名义同居。后来，他们搬至霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）钱家塘吉祥坊84号。
妻子私奔后，刘子容向警方报案，并将所有家具搬回旧居。随后，他重返学校继续学业。

The following advertisement published by the
Stadium Dance Hall appeared in the "Hsi Shih Chia" 戲世界),
"Cheng Pao" (正報), "Wei Pao" (彙報), "Hollywood Pao"
(好萊塢), "Sun Pao" (生報), "Wha Pao" (華報) and
"Crystal" (晶報), mosquito papers, on August 15, 1939 :-

We will offer as from to-day an unprecedented
kind of performance which is far superior to the "Sun Bath"
and "Models." The players in the performance will all
appear entirely coverless from head to toes. In addition,
Hula-Hula Dance will be exhibited, in the course of which
new and strange songs will be sung and comical expressions
will be used. It is an exhibition of beauty of health.
The place will be open throughout the night
and the public is hereby advised to come early in order
to avoid being unable to secure seats.
Address : the original site of the Stadium
Dog Racing Ground at the corner of Connaught and Yenping
Roads.

(This advertisement also appears in the
"Fun Pao" (奮報), "Hsi Pao" (戲報), "Tao Sheh Sin Wan
Pao" (桃色新聞報), "Sing Pao" (迅報), "Robinhood"
羅賓漢) and the above 7 mosquito papers on August 16, 1939.)
(The "China Evening News"大晚報 of August 15,
1939, also contained this advertisement.)

ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE EXHIBITION OF THE "CRYSTAL LIGHT"
IN THE WELTON CABARET

The Welton Cabaret (?) at No. 1401 Yu
Yuen Road publishes the following advertisement in the
"Sin Wan Pao" to-day :-
We are offering for the amusement of our
patrons an exhibition of the "Crystal Light." All
male patrons enjoy it with pleasure but ladies on
noticing it cry "Shame, Shame!" Three such performances
are given nightly. As soon as the light is exhibited,
our lady patrons become shy and try to hide themselves.
In addition to the above performances,
we offer for the enjoyment of our patrons to-night the
performance known as "Spring House." Whoever desires
to know particulars of this play has only to ask his
friends who have already seen it.
In addition, the Bingo Jack Pot is drawn
twice every night, while Champion tickets are drawn
once every hour. In addition to the cash prize of $50,
gifts will be offered to those who are in possession
of the drawn numbers.

（批：S. S. Liao, Pnt 11/4）
（批：11/4）

威尔顿歌舞厅（Welton Cabaret）“水晶灯”展览广告

愚园路1401号的威尔顿歌舞厅（?）今日在《辛晚报》（Sin Wan Pao）上刊登以下广告：
为供顾客娱乐，我们提供“水晶灯”展览。所有男性顾客皆乐在其中，但女士们见状则高呼“羞耻，羞耻！”每晚举行三次此类表演。灯光一亮，我们的女顾客便变得害羞并试图躲藏。
除上述表演外，今晚我们还为供顾客欣赏，提供名为“春宫”的表演。欲知该剧详情者，只需询问已观看过的朋友即可。
此外，每晚抽取两次宾果大奖（Bingo Jack Pot），每小时抽取一次冠军票。除50元现金奖励外，持有中奖号码者还将获得礼品。

（批：S. S. Liao, Pnt 11/4）
（批：11/4）

Summary of a Chinese drama entitled "THE HOUSE OF MR.WONG"

In 1925 there was in Soochow a family by the surname
Wong. This family consisted of the following members :-
1) Wong Vee Zung, age about 40, eldest brother, married, whose
first wife died years ago and whose second wife was young,
cunning and actually the ruling member of the family.
Wong Vee Zung who was working in a government organization,
was a henpecked husband but committed secret adultery with
his maid servant.
2) Wong Vee Nyi, age about 30, second brother, married,
unemployed, fond of gambling and associated with people
of the loafer type.
3) Wong Vee Li, age over 20, third brother, university student,
intelligent and capable youth. His fiancee lived with the
same family.
4) Wong Vee Feng, young sister, age about 20, girl student.
Wong Vee Zung's wife, apart from committing adultery
with the second brother, had another sweetheart who was very
rich. Thus she used to go out in the night. It was at her
instigation, the young sister made acquaintance with a young
fellow whose father was the superior officer of Wong Vee Zung.
She used to instruct the servants to keep a lookout on the
movements of the other members of the family and to spread
rumours unfavourable to the third brother and the wife of the
second brother.
On seeing his wife's conduct, Wong Vee Zung began
to commit adultery with a maid servant with the hope that he
would get a son.
From time to time Wong Vee Nyi, the second brother,
got financial aid from his eldest brother's wife.
While Wong Vee Li, the third brother, was at home
on holiday leave, the wife of the second brother attempted

一部名为《黄公馆》的中国戏剧剧情概要

1925年，苏州有一个姓黄的家庭。该家庭成员如下：
1) 黄维宗 (Wong Vee Zung)，约40岁，长兄，已婚，原配多年前去世，续弦年轻、狡猾，实际上是家庭的掌权者。黄维宗在政府机构任职，是个怕老婆的丈夫，但暗中与女仆通奸。
2) 黄维义 (Wong Vee Nyi)，约30岁，二弟，已婚，失业，好赌，并与游手好闲之徒交往。
3) 黄维礼 (Wong Vee Li)，20多岁，三弟，大学生，聪明能干的青年。他的未婚妻同住在这户人家。
4) 黄维凤 (Wong Vee Feng)，小妹，约20岁，女学生。
黄维宗的妻子除了与二弟通奸外，还有另一个非常富有的情人。因此她常在夜间外出。在她的唆使下，小妹结识了一个年轻人，其父是黄维宗的上司。她常指示仆人监视其他家庭成员的行踪，并散布对三弟和二弟妻子不利的谣言。
看到妻子的行为后，黄维宗开始与一名女仆通奸，希望能生个儿子。
二弟黄维义不时从大嫂那里获得经济资助。
当三弟黄维礼在家休假时，二弟的妻子试图

pages.en:
(2)

to seduce him but without result. Having been disappointed,
she committed adultery with the private ricsha coolie in the
family.

Wong Vee Feng became pregnant, but the rich young
fellow refused to marry her and left her alone.

Upon learning the corrupt conditions in the family,
Wong Vee Li discussed ways and means to save the family
with his fiancee.

After discovering that his wife was unfaithful to
him, the second brother assaulted his wife and as a result,
the wife in the night committed suicide by jumping into a
river.

All the members of the family turned out but not the
wife of the eldest brother who was out with her rich sweetheart.
The dead body was found and in the late hours that night,
the wife of the eldest brother was seen by the family returning
in a motor car driven by her sweetheart.

When asked about the cause of the death, the eldest
sister-in-law argued and her attitude was very stubborn.

Realizing that it was totally due the corrupt practice
of the wife of the eldest brother, the second brother repented
and killed her with a pistol and afterwards he shot himself.

Following the incident, the family became prosperous
again.

黄维凤怀孕了，但那个富家子弟拒绝娶她，将她抛弃。

得知家庭内部的腐败状况后，黄维礼与未婚妻商讨挽救家庭的办法。

二弟发现妻子对自己不忠后，殴打了妻子，导致妻子在夜间跳河自杀。

全家成员都出来了，唯独大嫂不在，她正与她富有的情人在一起。尸体被发现后，深夜时分，家人看到大嫂坐着情人驾驶的汽车回来。

当被问及死因时，大嫂强词夺理，态度十分顽固。

二弟意识到这完全是由于大嫂的腐败行径所致，后悔不已，用手枪杀死了她，随后自杀。

此事之后，家庭再次兴旺起来。

pages.en:
Translation of extracts from the dialogue book of a Chinese
drama entitled "THE HOUSE OF MR. WONG"

Act I - Page 15

Eldest brother's wife : You needn't say. I have heard all.
I destroy your family. Good! It is
I who ruins your family. I have no
repentance. Vee Li (3rd brother), I
wish to destroy your family totally.
I don't wish to hear your advice.
I wish to wait till you use your real
strength to struggle with me.

Act II - Pages 6 & 7

Eldest brother : Third brother, besides feeling disappointed
about the family, I also feel that there
is no way ahead for the country. During
the past few years, young fellows have
suffered their greatest sacrifice for the
country. I am a government official.
I understand more clearly that there is
no hope for the country. It is only
because of money that one becomes an
official in a place which is a thousand
miles away from his native village.
I like to ask how many officials are
there who do not know wealth. The
more rich the officials are, the more
poor the people will be. Presently,
China will soon be ruined. If we
see that the family and the country
will be soon ruined why should we
look for trouble? ..........

Third brother : Eldest brother, your words give me
pain. You are too pessimistic.
You should be optimistic.

第一幕 - 第15页

大嫂：你不必说了。我都听到了。
我毁了你们的家。好！就是
我毁了你们的家。我毫无
悔意。维礼（三弟），我
希望彻底毁灭你们的家庭。
我不想听你的劝告。
我要等到你使出真本事
来与我斗争。

第二幕 - 第6 & 7页

大哥：三弟，除了对家庭感到失望
外，我也觉得国家前途无望。过去
几年，年轻人为国家做出了最大的
牺牲。我是一名政府官员。我更清
楚地知道国家没有希望。人们只是
为了金钱才远离家乡千里之外去做
官。我想问问，有多少官员是不贪
财的？官员越富有，百姓就越贫穷。
目前，中国很快就要灭亡了。如果我
们看到家庭和国家即将灭亡，何必自
找麻烦呢？ ____

三弟：大哥，你的话让我痛苦。你太
悲观了。你应该乐观一些。

We should believe ourselves. We

strength to reform this world.
Although we are pained, yet if we
unite and abandon all private feelings,
there will be a hope for the country
and we can also change the evils of the
society into brightness. If the
family is declining, we can stir it up.
We live in this world. Our responsibility
is to give up our lives for the country.
There are a number of weak countries
which have now become revived. Is
it not due to this sort of spirit?

they were talking about. I thought
that they were talking about certain
affairs. I did not suspect anything.
To-morrow, I will fix them, that pair

Servant Woo : It is heard that it is because of

Wife of eldest brother : Let the child be born. Nowadays,

Wife of eldest brother : Vee Li (3rd brother), you needn't say

reached already the last step. My
attitude is very simple. I shall

I wish to tell you clearly that it

的手段。但是，维利，
我希望你意识到这一点：我之所以能够
毁灭你们的家庭，是由于得到了
“内奸”的协助
我付出了最大的牺牲才
勾结（? 关联）上你们家中的
一名“内奸”。他是你们
最大的敌人。现在我必须告诉你们他
是谁。他是你们家中
最难对付、同时也最容易被
收买的人。现在我来告诉
你们他的名字。
（当她看到维尼——二哥，也就是
所谓的“内奸”——时，她停止了
说话。此时，维尼恨她入骨，用手枪
杀死了她。）
